episodes.161137: Numerous thunderstorms developed during the afternoon and evening ahead of a weak boundary, as deep moisture and an upper-level disturbance moved across the area. Cold temperatures aloft caused one of the storms to become severe, resulting in quarter-sized hail.
episodes.161138: Numerous thunderstorms developed in the afternoon and evening hours ahead of a boundary, as deep moisture and an upper-level disturbance moved across the area. Cold temperatures aloft allowed a few of the storms to become strong to severe, with quarter-sized hail and strong wind gusts occurring as they approached and moved offshore the coast near Vero Beach.
episodes.161774: A mudslide coming down Whitney Creek on the northwest slope of Mount Shasta impacted Highway 97. This occurred at 0507 PDT on 09/10/21.  0.4 to 0.7 inches of rain fell in the area over four hours. This slide was likely due to the rainfall, combined with glacial melt from the Whitney Glacier.  The slide closed Highway 97 for a short time, and one semitrailer truck was stuck in the mud.  No injuries or fatalities occurred.
episodes.161838: A mix of wet and dry thunderstorms across Nevada produced gusty winds.
episodes.162261: Weak disturbances combined mid-level lapse rates above 9C/km brought a couple rounds of scattered afternoon showers and thunderstorms over Southwestern MT. A very dry boundary layer supported strong downdrafts that subsequently produced strong to severe wind gusts.
episodes.162527: An upper-level disturbance moved across Wyoming, leading to the development of showers and thunderstorms. Very dry conditions at the surface within a hot airmass generated large dewpoint depressions. As a result, dry microbursts and strong outflow wind occurred ahead of showers and thunderstorms, primarily across Fremont and Sweetwater counties. Winds gusted as high as 68 mph at Southwest Wyoming Regional Airport near Rock Springs and 60 to 65 mph in the vicinity of Lander and Riverton.
episodes.162556: Watersport observed 3 miles south off the south coast of Patillas, PR.
episodes.162869: Scattered thunderstorms produced heavy rain and severe wind gusts across the Inland Empire, mountains and deserts on Thursday, September 9, leading to flooding, debris flows and rock slides. Elevated convection also made it to the coast on September 9. On September 10, severe thunderstorms producing heavy rainfall impacted the lower deserts.
episodes.163023: Thunderstorm outflows created strong wind gusts.
episodes.163097: A slow moving cold front moved across Massachusetts during the day and evening. Bands of heavy rain moved across southeast Massachusetts, with localized very heavy amounts on Cape Cod and Martha's Vineyard.
episodes.163139: A small push of monsoon moisture fueled isolated thunderstorms over southern Nevada. Isolated severe winds and lightning injuries occurred.
episodes.163422: Thunderstorms brought strong wind gusts across portions of northern Utah and flash flooding to portions of southern Utah.
episodes.163549: A waterspout developed in association with a convective rain shower along a residual outflow boundary.
